items.dom_path: PAGA 2018 (2nd Ed.) > Aerobic, Muscle-Strengthening & Multicomponent Benchmarks
items.section: PAGA 2018 Core Benchmarks (EXW 101, EXW 210 & EXW 265)
items.text: In plain English: The Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans (PAGA), 2nd Edition (2018) is the Academic Source of Truth for EXW 101 and EXW 265 (and foundational movement in EXW 210). Key rules: (1) Adults need 150 to 300 minutes/week of moderate-intensity aerobic activity (3.0–5.9 METs) OR 75 to 150 minutes/week of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity (>=6.0 METs), plus muscle-strengthening activities targeting all major muscle groups on >=2 days/week; (2) Youth (ages 6–17) require >=60 minutes/day of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (including bone- and muscle-strengthening >=3 days/week); (3) Older adults (>=65 years) require multicomponent physical activity combining balance training, aerobic, and muscle-strengthening to prevent falls; (4) Every minute counts (the legacy 10-minute bout rule was eliminated in the 2nd Edition).

items.section: 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans ('Real Food' Focus — EXW 150)
items.text: In plain English: The 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans ('Real Food' Focus) is the Academic Source of Truth for EXW 150 (Nutrition for Exercise & Sport). Key rules: (1) Prioritize whole, minimally processed nutrient-dense 'Real Foods' over ultra-processed supplements and proprietary blends; (2) Limit added sugars to <10% of total daily kcal and saturated fat to <10% of total daily kcal, with sodium <2,300 mg/day (adjusted clinically for documented high-heat sweat sodium losses in Yuma >110°F environments); (3) Acceptable Macronutrient Distribution Ranges (AMDR): Carbohydrates 45–65% (3–10 g/kg/day scaled to training volume), Protein 10–35% (1.2–2.0 g/kg/day for strength/endurance athletes), Fat 20–35%; (4) Fluid replacement: 125–150% of acute body-mass fluid deficit (~16–24 oz per lb of sweat lost) with whole-food electrolytes.

items.dom_path: ACSM 12th Ed. (2025) > Preparticipation Screening, FITT-VP & Cycle Ergometry
items.section: ACSM's Guidelines for Exercise Testing and Prescription, 12th Edition (EXW 245 & EXW 210)
items.text: In plain English: ACSM's Guidelines for Exercise Testing and Prescription, 12th Edition (effective July 10, 2025) is the Academic Source of Truth for EXW 245 (Exercise Testing & Prescription) and clinical testing in EXW 210. Key rules: (1) Apply the ACSMPreparticipation Screening algorithm (current activity level + known CV/metabolic/renal disease + signs/symptoms + desired intensity) before any graded exercise test (GXT); (2) FITT-VP principle (Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type, Volume, Progression) using Karvonen Heart Rate Reserve (Target HR = [(HRmax - HRrest) x %Intensity] + HRrest) and VO2R / MET metabolic equations; (3) Enforce absolute and relative test termination criteria (e.g., drop in SBP >=10 mmHg with increasing workload, SBP >250 mmHg or DBP >115 mmHg, onset of angina, ataxia/dizziness) and post-exercise thermal safety in Yuma desert conditions.

items.ssot: PAGA 2018 (2nd Ed.); ACSM 12th Ed. (2025); and NASM Optimum Performance Training (OPT) Model
items.dom_path: NASM OPT Model > Stabilization, Strength & Power Phases (EXW 210)
items.section: NASM Optimum Performance Training (OPT) Model & Tri-SSoT Integration (EXW 210)
items.text: In plain English: EXW 210 (Essentials of Personal Fitness Training) integrates three Academic Sources of Truth: PAGA 2018 (2nd Ed.), ACSM 12th Ed. (2025), and the National Academy of Sports Medicine (NASM) Optimum Performance Training (OPT) Model. Key OPT rules: (1) Level 1 — Stabilization Endurance (Phase 1: 12–20 reps, 50–70% 1RM, slow 4-2-1-1 tempo, proprioceptive/core stability before heavy loading); (2) Level 2 — Strength (Phase 2 Strength Endurance supersets, Phase 3 Muscular Development 6–12 reps at 75–85% 1RM, Phase 4 Maximal Strength 1–5 reps at 85–100% 1RM); (3) Level 3 — Power (Phase 5 Power supersetting 85–100% 1RM strength with 30–45% 1RM or 10% body-weight explosive speed-strength). Always correct Overhead Squat Assessment (OHSA) movement compensations (overactive vs. underactive muscles) first.

items.section: GraphQL Introduction
items.text: GraphQL is a query API language that executes queries by using a type system based on defined input data. GraphQL provides more specific inquiries with faster results and populate multiple inputs into one query. Note: GraphQL endpoint permissions mirror permissions for the REST API. A user is only granted access to view grades based on that user’s permissions. For instance, a student cannot view grades for another student, but an instructor can view grades for any student in a course. Learn more about GraphQL.

items.section: **SECTION 1: MASTER ARCHITECT'S VISION & ONTOLOGY**
items.text: This log serves as the continuous running repository and Single Source of Truth (SSoT) for emerging concepts, tools, and institutional frameworks across Curriculum as Code (CaC), Curriculum as a Service (CaaS), and Compliance as Code. By treating educational materials as structured, auditable software assets rather than static documents, I aim to maximize institutional agility, enforce born-accessible civil rights compliance (ADA Title II / WCAG 2.2 AA 9:1 Double-Contrast Guard / WCAG 3.0 APCA), and secure data sovereignty.

items.section: Healthy Dietary Patterns Include
items.text: * Vegetables: All types, including dark green, red and orange, legumes (beans and peas), starchy, and other vegetables. * Fruits: Especially whole fruits. * Grains: At least half of which are whole grains. * Dairy: Fat-free or low-fat milk, yogurt, cheese, and/or fortified soy beverages. * Protein Foods: Lean meats, poultry, and eggs; seafood; beans, peas, and lentils; and nuts, seeds, and soy products. * Oils: Vegetable oils and oils in food, such as seafood and nuts.

items.text: *Un 0 / 10 (Recalibrate) nunca es un castigo definitivo; es una pausa de seguridad clínica y una invitación abierta para corregir y volver a entregar por el 10 / 10 completo. Entra a la pestaña Grades (Calificaciones) en Canvas, lee el comentario de Coach Alan en SpeedGrader, corrige el Patrón / Regla / Solución, tu cálculo de ACSM o tu Verificación Activa de 150 palabras, y haz clic en New Attempt (Nuevo Intento). Tienes intentos ilimitados durante todo el semestre.* ---
